variables.problem: An investment of $5,000 grows 20% in year one, loses 15% in year two, then grows 10% in year three. What is its value at the end of year three, in dollars?
A shop marks up an item by 40% over cost, then advertises 25% off the marked price. A customer pays $84. What was the shop's cost, in dollars?
An item is priced at $200. A coupon takes 15% off the pre-tax price, then 8% sales tax is applied to the discounted amount. What is the final amount paid, in dollars?
A store buys 240 units at $18 each. It sells 60% of them at $32 each, and the remainder at 25% off that $32 price. What is the store's total profit, in dollars?
A factory produces 480 units per day. Quality control rejects 7.5% of them. The accepted units are packed 16 to a case, and only full cases are shipped. How many cases ship per day?
A recipe serving 6 people needs 450 g of flour. You want to serve 15 people but have only 1 kg of flour. How many grams short are you?
A tank fills at 12 litres per minute while simultaneously draining at 5 litres per minute. It starts with 80 litres and holds 500 litres. How many minutes until it is full?
Three workers together can paint a house in 12 days. After 4 days of all three working, one worker leaves. How many more days do the remaining two need to finish?
A car travels 150 km at 50 km/h, then 200 km at 80 km/h. What is the average speed for the entire trip in km/h, to one decimal place?

A train leaves a station at 9:00 travelling 60 km/h. A second train leaves the same station at 10:30 travelling 90 km/h in the same direction. How many minutes after 10:30 does the second train catch the first?
A 40% salt solution is mixed with a 15% salt solution to produce 500 mL of a 25% solution. How many millilitres of the 40% solution are required?
A subscription costs $12 per month, or $120 for a full year paid upfront. You need it for exactly 30 months and may combine annual and monthly purchases. What is the lowest total cost, in dollars?
